author: Microsoft
name: macOS File System Extension
description: A project for creating an FSKit file system extension for a .NET macOS application
postActions/addProjectReference/descript: Add project reference in main app's project file
postActions/addProjectReference/manualIn:
The final step is to add a reference to this newly created project in the main app's project file, like this:

	<ItemGroup>
		<ProjectReference Include="macOSFSKitExtension1.csproj">
			<IsAppExtension>true</IsAppExtension>
		</ProjectReference>
	</ItemGroup>
symbols/bundleId/description: The bundle identifier (CFBundleIdentifier from the Info.plist, or ApplicationId from the project file) for the parent macOS project
symbols/minOSVersion/description: Overrides SupportedOSPlatformVersion in the project file
symbols/fileSystemClassName/description: The name of the class that implements the file system
symbols/Framework/description: The target framework for the project.
